messages:
maria: Heads-up: docsite CI linkcheck is failing on the latest mkdocs migration — several fragments now 404.
docsite-ci: Linkcheck failed for /guides/migrate#default-params (404), /api/embeddings#usage (404)
sam: ugh, this is the punctuation-in-heading slug change again? Did we switch slugifier when converting to mkdocs-material?
lee: I saw similar when we flipped on mkdocs-plugin-anchors. Old anchors included colons and parentheses; new slugify removes them.
maria: Can we special-case by adding explicit ids in frontmatter or in the headings? e.g., `### Request params {#request-params}`
julian: That works but there are dozens. Maybe normalise with a small regex in the linker plugin.
alexa: Quick patch idea — run a script to backfill explicit header ids for headings matching links referenced from other pages, then run linkcheck again.
sam: +1. Also we should avoid changing use_directory_urls for now; that broke some path expectations.
maria: Here's a tiny script proposal:
```
# scripts/backfill_header_ids.py
import re,sys
from urllib.parse import quote

def slugify(text):
    s = text.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 _-]", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[\s_]+", "-", s).strip('-')
    return s

for f in sys.argv[1:]:
  s=open(f,'r',encoding='utf-8').read()
  s=re.sub(r'^(##+\s+)(.+)$', lambda m: f"{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)} {{#{slugify(m.group(2))}}}", s, flags=re.M)
  open(f,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s)
```

lee: maybe run only on docs/*.md and commit; we should also add a test mapping old anchor -> new anchor in the repo so CI can detect drift.
docsite-ci: Scheduled linkcheck re-run in 10m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
maria: I'll open a small PR (changes only to markdown, add migration-note in CONTRIBUTING). tagging @devex for review.
julian: please include a short migration note: "If you link to a heading that contains punctuation, prefer explicit `{#id}` to avoid slugifier changes."
alexa: FYI I found one weird case: `C++ API` becomes `c-api` not `c++-api` — we should add a short mapping table to the docs.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — small backfill + CI config tweak. please review :eyes: 
sam: reviewing now.
docsite-ci: Linkcheck finished. Remaining 2 failures: /api/embeddings#usage (404), /guides/migrate#query-conventions (404)
lee: those two are legit; I'll patch them in the PR with explicit ids.
maria: ok landed fixes, running linkcheck again.
